dedupe_keys.name: dynamic edge ai service management and adaptation via off policy meta reinforcement learning and digital twin

description: The model adapts edge-AI service-management policies when changing AI applications alter resource requirements and performance. Digital-twin environments emulate encountered conditions and train a meta-policy through off-policy reinforcement learning. The policy is then adapted from a limited transition context for new conditions. Simulations report improved service quality and adaptation. This establishes a source-described digital-twin and resource-management model, without proving continuous synchronization with an operational installation.
